title: São Tomé and Príncipe: National Sustainable Development Strategy (ENDS) 2026-2040
publisher: Governo de São Tomé e Príncipe
why_not: fetched and read in full; adopted in-window and a genuine national instrument, but it treats digitalisation only as an enabler of financial services and governance and says nothing about ICT sector size, software or IT services production, so it does not move this indicator. Belongs to a national strategy indicator, not to this one.
